d: We are looking for a motivated Newgen Developer to join our Newgen Application Development Center (ADC) team supporting lending and SME financing platforms. You will help build, configure, and integrate workflow and document-management solutions on the Newgen platform, working closely with senior developers, business analysts, and QA teams in a regulated banking environment.
q: The ideal candidate with 1–2 years of hands-on Newgen experience in a bank or fintech. They:
Have worked on at least one end-to-end lending or SME financing workflow on Newgen iBPS.
Are comfortable with both configuration (process modeling, forms) and coding (Java, SQL).
Understand how workflows connect to core banking and CRM systems through APIs.
Are detail-oriented and understand the discipline needed for banking compliance, audit trails, and controlled releases.
Learn quickly, take feedback well, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
Can work independently on well-defined tasks and escalate blockers early.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in Newgen development, with banking/fintech experience required .
Newgen iBPS (BPM): workflow design, process modeling, forms, rules, and queue configuration.
Newgen OmniDocs (ECM): document management, folder and document configuration, access control.
Java: solid fundamentals (OOP, exception handling, collections).
SQL: writing queries, joins, stored procedures, and performance basics (Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).
API integration: REST and SOAP, JSON/XML, web services, and integration with core banking and CRM systems.
Understanding of deployment processes and DR concepts (backup, failover, recovery).
Familiarity with SME/retail lending workflows (origination, credit assessment, approval, disbursement).
Good communication in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
Teamwork and ability to work with business and IT stakeholders.
Ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
Experience with Agile/Scrum and tools such as Jira and Git.
Knowledge of SAMA regulations and information security practices.
Exposure to DevOps or CI/CD pipelines.
r: li
Design, develop, and configure business workflows on Newgen iBPS (BPM) for lending and SME financing processes.
li
Implement document management solutions using Newgen OmniDocs (ECM) , including document types, folder structures, access rights, and retention rules.
li
Build and customize forms, rules, and process logic based on business requirements.
li
Develop Java components and SQL queries, procedures, and scripts to support workflow and reporting needs.
li
Develop and consume REST/SOAP APIs to integrate Newgen with core banking and CRM systems.
li
Participate in requirement analysis and translate business needs into technical solutions.
li
Perform unit testing, support SIT/UAT, and fix defects promptly.
li
Support deployment activities across environments (Dev, Test, UAT, Production), including release documentation.
li
Support Disaster Recovery (DR) readiness, including DR setup validation and drills.
li
Provide L2/L3 production support, troubleshoot incidents, and perform root-cause analysis.
li
Maintain technical documentation (design documents, configuration guides, integration specs).
li
Follow bank/fintech security, change management, and compliance standards.
